Subject: Harper Analytics — onboarding: usage snapshot & context needs

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As promised I'm attaching a small usage snapshot that summarizes our current query mix and a handful of representative docs. High-level: we have a search/assistant feature embedded in our product and want to route short queries to a smaller model while keeping the option for long-document summarization and Q&A (up to ~8k tokens) for some workflows.

Quick asks for your onboarding team:
- Can you propose a 3-variant model shortlist (low / mid / high quality) with rough per-token cost estimates?
- We also need an initial token-traffic estimate (monthly token volume + peak TPS) so procurement can size the commitment.
- Any constraints around context length support or recommendations for chunking/streaming would be helpful.

Attached: harper_usage_snapshot.csv (sample traffic + request size distribution).

We'd like to move to a tech kickoff next week if the timeline works.

Thanks,
Anna

Harper Analytics

On Tue, May 1, 2028 at 11:04 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick questions:
> - The CSV has "avg_request_tokens" and an "outlier_docs" column — can you confirm how often those outliers occur (percent of requests)?

Hi Dylan — good questions. Answers below.

- Outliers: roughly 6% of requests fall into the "long" bucket (documents > 3k tokens), and about 1.2% exceed 6k. The vast majority (~70%) are short queries under 250 tokens.
- Long-doc flow: We'd prefer to send the full doc in a single request where possible (simpler UX) — but we can support chunked uploads if you recommend it for performance/cost reasons.
- Latency: interactive search needs 200–300ms median; summarization can be higher (1.5–2s).

Also adding Procurement on the thread for sizing/PO questions.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lee
Head of Product, Harper Analytics
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@harperanalytics.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-02T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Model shortlist + initial token-traffic estimates

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick follow-up and the data. Drafting a concise recommendation here so procurement and product have something to review before kickoff.

Summary (draft):
- Observed traffic profile: 70% short (<250 tokens), 24.8% mid (250–3k), 6% long (>3k), 1.2% extreme (>6k). Peak TPS observed in sample: 12 TPS sustained during business hours, bursts to ~35 TPS for short windows.

Model shortlist (3 variants) — tradeoffs and notes:
1) Cost-first (recommended for low-latency search paths): 7B open model (float16/Q4 quantized) — good latency, best cost, handles up to 4k tokens practically, lower quality on edge cases.
2) Balanced (recommended default): 13B model (bf16 or int8 profile) — solid quality for summarization and chat, supports 8k context with tuned kernels, moderate cost.
3) High-quality (for long-document summarization): 70B+ dense model (mixed precision or offload profile) — best quality on long-context, higher cost and operational complexity (we recommend routing only the long-doc summarizations here).

Token-traffic sizing (conservative / expected / aggressive):
- Monthly tokens (conservative): 35M tokens
- Monthly tokens (expected): 85M tokens
- Monthly tokens (aggressive ramp): 210M tokens

Peak sizing guidance:
- Baseline pool for search path (low-latency): 6 dedicated vGPU workers (13B or 7B depending on final mix) to hold 200–300ms median SLO with sustained 12 TPS and brief bursts to 35 TPS.
- Long-doc summarization: autoscale group that spins to handle spikes; keep a soft-cap of 6k context for heavy requests.

Recommendations / next steps:
- Confirm whether Harper wants to 1) prioritize cost (favor 7B for search) or 2) prioritize quality (default to 13B). We can present a hybrid routing policy (search->7B, summarization->13B or 70B) to control costs.
- Procurement: we'll provide a 90-day ramp plan that maps tokens to reserved capacity pricing and a shortfall protection policy.
- Tech kickoff: propose Wed 2028-05-09 10:00 AM PT — 45 minutes (architecture + SLOs + data handling).

Attachments: proposed-model-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 52KB)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HarperOnboard

Let me know if you'd like the token estimate table expanded line-by-line (we can include a per-route token mix with expected percent split).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
